note: Every figure has a source and the date it was checked. 'assumption': true marks values we could not confirm from an authoritative, current source; they are listed on every quote that uses them.

gst.note: Import GST is charged at 9% on CIF value + duties + incidental charges.

low_value_goods.note: Overseas vendors registered under the OVR regime charge GST at checkout on low-value goods (<= S$400 per item, sales value excluding separately charged freight and insurance) shipped by air or post; not charged again at import.

import_relief.note: GST import relief for CIF <= S$400 applies to air/post only, NOT sea or land. Above S$400, import GST is due on the ENTIRE CIF value.

duty.note: Only intoxicating liquors, tobacco, motor vehicles and petroleum products are dutiable; furniture attracts GST only.

ikea_sg.note: Per ORDER. Parcel delivery S$10 (<= 15 kg, items under 1.4 m); orders over 16 kg up to 25 kg S$20; home delivery S$35. No-lift surcharge (S$20, 3rd-5th floor) not modelled.

castlery.note: Per ORDER, by order total. Peak-slot and carry-up surcharges not modelled.

other_sg.note: Unknown retailer delivery policy; treated as free and flagged.

sea_bulky_cny.note: Cainiao consolidated sea 'bulky' tariff as reported in 2020: RMB225 flat up to 0.5 CBM, RMB450 per CBM above. Stale; a seller- or consolidator-quoted fee on the listing always overrides it.

air_sgd_per_kg.note: No authoritative current air rate found; placeholder. Used only for listings marked ships_by=air without a quoted fee.

last_mile_sgd.note: Consolidated shipments are usually delivered to the door; bulky/stairs surcharges vary by forwarder and are not modelled.

typical_by_item_type.note: Rough packed size/weight per item type, used ONLY when a listing gives none. Quotes using these are marked estimated.

fx.note: Stale = our cached copy is more than 24 h old (ECB does not publish on weekends, so the rate's own date can be older).
